clips.title: The story
paras: Corporal Melkins at Nijel's Point says every centaur clan in Desolace shares one trait, cruelty, and that peace will not come while the centaur remain. Melkins asks you to hunt them across the land and bring fifteen of their ears.

At Nijel's Point, Corporal Melkins describes a centaur race split among many clans, each with a leader and plans of its own, yet alike in cruelty. Peace, Melkins says, will only come if the centaurs are removed.
Wandering Desolace, you hunt centaur and take their ears. Melkins wants a great many, fifteen in all, and calls the work a service to the Alliance that brings the war's end nearer.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Many clans make up the centaur race. Each has its own leader and agenda, but all the clans have one thing in common. Cruelty.
If we are to ever find peace, then the centaurs must be removed. And so I put you on the task to do just that.
While wandering Desolace, hunt centaur and take their ears. Bring me many, many ears.
Do this in service of the Alliance, friend, and we will be one step closer to war's end.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have a report, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your service to the Alliance is unquestioned, friend. The blood you spilled in Desolace will, no doubt, save countless lives.
